QuestInfo.name: The Lone Girl
QuestInfo.0: You met Anne, a girl who plays by herself. Talk to her again see if there's anything you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1: Destroy the Curse Eyes on Green Tree Trunk to retrieve #b3 of Anne's Teddy Bears#k.
QuestInfo.2: You returned Anne's lost dolls. Now try Shane.\r\n#b(Head down past Anne to find Shane. You can check her location by clicking the 'NPC' button on the mini map on the upper left.)

0.0: Dying...of boredom...\r\n#L0##bYou must be Anne. I've been sent by Grendel to solve your problems.#l\n#k
0.1: Mom told me not to talk to strangers!\r\n#L0##bYou've nothing to fear from me, child! Now, how may I be of service?#l\n#k
0.2: If you say so... Mom made some teddy bears, but the mean old monsters stole 'em. Now I don't have anyone to play with...

yes.0: The #bCurse Eyes#k in Ellinia Forest took them. You'll get all  3 back for me, won't you?

1.0: Did you find my dolls?\r\n#L0##bYour bear dolls are safe.#l\n#k

yes.0: Shane seems upset. He's strange, but he's not a bad guy. Help him too.\r\n#b(Head down past Anne to find Shane.)

item.0: Where are my teddy bears? They were my only friends...
